representation_plans.learner_operation: Evaluate one quantitative ratio statement and one semilog repeated-halving statement independently.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State the scientific-notation ratio and the logarithmic-vertical-axis repeated-halving claim as two labelled text statements, Q and G.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Calculate change in log10(remaining amount) divided by elapsed time from a fresh coordinate pair.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State both time and log10(remaining amount) coordinates in text, then ask for signed vertical change per hour.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Separate identity, nucleon count, weighted average, and binding evidence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State symbol, atomic number, mass number, proton and neutron counts, isotope abundances, and any supplied binding data in a linear list.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Conserve mass number and atomic number independently across decay.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State parent A and Z, emitted particle A and Z, and daughter A and Z as aligned text rows.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Relate equal time intervals to multiplicative halving across equation, table, and graph.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Provide time and remaining-amount pairs and identify whether the vertical axis is linear amount or logarithm of amount.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Use m/z, charge state, peak role, and fragment differences as separate identity constraints.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List every relevant peak by m/z and relative intensity, identify any supplied charge state and parent/fragment role, and state numerical differences.
